title: Costroid receipt, version 0.1
description: The token counts of a developer's own agent sessions on one branch, as costroid receipt prints them for the developer to post on the pull request. It states counts and never an amount: no cost, no price and no currency. Every string is a closed word, a day or a pattern, and no field holds text a person or a model wrote.

written.description: The UTC day the receipt was written.

since.description: The lower bound: the UTC day of the oldest entry of the branch's reflog on the machine. A session that ended before it is not counted. Null when the reflog holds no entry for the branch, so the receipt states no lower bound.

agents.description: The agents whose session files were read, each once. This version reads Claude Code's alone. An agent that was read and held no session is named too.

sessions.description: One entry per session, model, service tier and region, at most 150.

sessions_omitted.description: The oldest sessions left out so that the receipt fits in one comment.

agent.description: The agents whose session files this version reads: Claude Code alone. A later version adds an agent.

branch.description: The branch the receipt is for, as git names it: letters, digits and . _ + - in components joined by /, opening with a letter or a digit. No component opens with a dot or ends with .lock, the name holds no .. and does not end with a dot, and it is never HEAD. A detached head has no branch and gets no receipt.

count.description: A whole number of tokens as a decimal string: no sign, no fraction, no leading zero, below 10^15. Never a JSON number.

agent_version.description: The agent's own version string, as its session file states it.

session_id.description: The agent's session id. A join, never a credential.

model.description: The model that served the requests, as the session file states it.

service_tier.description: The service tier as the catalog names it. Null when the session file states none.

region.description: The region the requests were held to. Null on default routing, which is no distinct region.

first_day.description: The UTC day of the entry's first request.

last_day.description: The UTC day of the entry's last request.

requests.description: The model requests the entry sums.

largest_input.description: The largest whole input of any one request the entry sums: its uncached input, its cache reads and its cache writes. It selects a context tier.

tokens.description: Token counts by billed class, as the row a run writes names them: uncached input, cache reads, cache writes at five minutes and at one hour, and output, each stated, 0 included. The informational classes repeat a billed class and are never stated.

assumed_ttl.description: The cache lifetimes an adapter's rule assigned because the session file did not state them, as the row's costroid/assumed_ttl tag names them. Absent when the file stated every lifetime.
